reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the pocket-sized sachet that tears open with one hand, because I forget bottles at home and live out of a tote bag. The QR on every sachet is a nice touch, and $1 a day is fine for one box to try.
objection: 30 little foil packets feels like more trash, and I already have a drawer of half-used bottles, so if I don't stick with it I've wasted the money.
